sakura_input_observed.note: Only the separately pinned research reference converter snapshots are used. Current production HEAD is recorded, not substituted for their identity.

populations: exact unique full-reading Top6 system-dictionary target with no input/candidate truncation
metrics: source/reading/form counts and reading-majority in-sample oracle
duplicate and contradictory literal context/reading inputs
exact source presence at Top1/5/6/10/32 with failures retained
source-balanced 25000 jawiki and 25000 aozora selection capacity
reading provenance, span and boundary evidence availability
orthographic/protection/meaning/intent evidence states, without automatic semantic labels

selection.control: Lowest stable IDs per corpus after refreshed isolation and candidate eligibility.
selection.contrast: One conservative four-distinct-component quartet per reading, ordered by canonical hash of reading; reserve all four only when both corpus quotas permit; fill each remaining quota by lowest stable IDs. No replacement, duplication, or evaluation-word matching.
selection.quantity_signal: A planning diagnostic passes only if both selections meet quotas and the contrast selection has at least twice as many four-component witnessed readings as control, with at least one witness in control. This measures intervention strength, not accuracy or label quality.

fit_rule: No fit in this feasibility unit. A later fit plan may be frozen only after quantity feasibility and documented reading/span/meaning/orthography evidence for reserved contrast rows have been checked. Missing evidence stays unresolved, never a valid label. Source-only weak supervision is not independent Gold.
history_access: Historical source metadata and bounded input hashes are used solely for exclusion closure. No evaluation label, prediction, missing-word list or score may guide grouping or selection. Selection consumes only the authenticated train list and converter snapshots indexed by its readings.
verification: Replay latest full source closure and compare all admitted IDs, row bytes, components and exclusions
Authenticate original full-reading candidate receipts and all referenced batch outputs
Independent Counter/set recounts, witness invariants and reverse-order replay
Hash-chain sidecars, unchanged source/baseline artifacts, bounded tests and no surviving owned process
